text: 依据《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》第四十一条规定，为了维护对外贸易秩序，商务部可以自行或者会同国务院其他有关部门，就对外贸易中有关国家安全利益的事项进行调查。初步信息显示，装有外国系统软件的进口打印复印办公设备可能影响对外贸易中的国家安全利益，符合《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》第四十一条规定的情形。
text_en: Pursuant to Article 41 of the Foreign Trade Law of the People's Republic of China, in order to maintain foreign trade order, the Ministry of Commerce may, on its own or together with other relevant State Council departments, investigate matters concerning national security interests in foreign trade. Preliminary information shows that imported printing, copying and office equipment installed with foreign system software may affect national security interests in foreign trade, conforming to the circumstances stipulated in Article 41 of the Foreign Trade Law of the People's Republic of China.
